يتداركون (form VI)
# يَتَدَارَكُونَ (yatadārakūna) /ja.ta.daː.ra.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَدَارَكَ (tadāraka)
# يُتَدَارَكُونَ (yutadārakūna) /ju.ta.daː.ra.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَدَارَكَ (tadāraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
